tools.name: search_news
tools.description: Newest-first headlines from worldwide sources, optionally filtered by words, language, country, topic, source, kind and time.

tools.name: sync_news
tools.description: Incremental feed: returns items added after `after`, oldest first, plus a new cursor. Call again with that cursor to get only what is new.

tools.name: list_stories
tools.description: The most widely covered stories right now (last 48h), each with a neutral multi-source brief when available, outlet count, languages, entities and a representative report. Filter by lang, country, category, entity.

tools.name: find_entities
tools.description: Look up Wikidata ids for a name (e.g. "Tesla", "Lagos") with how many items mention each in the last 7 days; pass the id as `entity` to search_news or list_stories.

tools.name: get_story
tools.description: Every item in a story (the `story` id on items, st_…): all outlets and languages covering the same event, newest first.

tools.name: get_news_item
tools.description: Full record for one item id (n_… for news, s_… for sponsored).

tools.name: list_sources
tools.description: Registered sources with their language, country, kind and health. Filter by q (name), country or lang.

tools.name: quote_placement
tools.description: Quote for placing a labeled, paid press release in the Hottub News mix via Hottub Business. Price varies by topic tier, current topic interest, demand, targeting reach and duration; the response itemizes each factor. Read-only: returns a price; books and charges nothing.

tools.name: news_stats
tools.description: Item counts over the last 24 hours by kind, language, country and source, plus the current sync cursor.
